Find Similar Pitcher Seasons

similar_pitchers.Rd

Finds the pitcher seasons most similar to a user-supplied statistical profile. Comparisons are restricted to pitcher seasons matching the selected starter and reliever classifications. Starter and reliever classifications manually imputed based on innings pitched, ratio of starts to relief outings, numerical gap in starts and games pitched, and subject matter knowledge.

Usage

similar_pitchers(
  lob_pct,
  gb_pct,
  hr_fb,
  k_pct,
  bb_pct,
  barrel_pct,
  hardhit_pct,
  is_starter,
  is_reliever,
  n = 5,
  data = Pitching
)

Arguments

lob_pct

Left-on-Base Percentage.

gb_pct

Ground Ball Percentage.

hr_fb

Home Run per Fly Ball Percentage.

k_pct

Strikeout Percentage.

bb_pct

Walk Percentage.

barrel_pct

Barrel Percentage.

hardhit_pct

Hard-Hit Percentage.

is_starter

Starter Indicator: either 0 or 1.

is_reliever

Reliever Indicator: either 0 or 1.

n

Number of similar player-seasons to return. Default is 5.

data

Pitching data frame. Default is Pitching.

Value

A data frame containing the most similar pitcher seasons.

Examples

## Traditional Starter Example
starter_results <- similar_pitchers(
  lob_pct = 81,
  gb_pct = 43,
  hr_fb = 9,
  k_pct = 30,
  bb_pct = 6,
  barrel_pct = 7,
  hardhit_pct = 38,
  is_starter = 1,
  is_reliever = 0,
  n = 10
)

## Traditional Reliever Example
reliever_results <- similar_pitchers(
  lob_pct = 77,
  gb_pct = 52,
  hr_fb = 13,
  k_pct = 38,
  bb_pct = 9,
  barrel_pct = 6,
  hardhit_pct = 42,
  is_starter = 0,
  is_reliever = 1,
  n = 10
)

## Swingman Example
swingman_results <- similar_pitchers(
  lob_pct = 72,
  gb_pct = 35,
  hr_fb = 7,
  k_pct = 20,
  bb_pct = 3,
  barrel_pct = 5,
  hardhit_pct = 30,
  is_starter = 1,
  is_reliever = 1,
  n = 10
)
